messages.content: 案件編號XY1234在Los Angeles County Court和案件編號GH5678在Orange County Court的狀態和預定審判日期是什麼？

function.name: court_info_get_case_status
function.description: Retrieves the status and trial dates for court cases from specified county courts. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

court.description: The county court where the case is filed.

details.description: Specific details required about the court case. Defaults to 'status'.

We need to call the function court_info_get_case_status twice: one for XY1234 in Los Angeles County Court, and one for GH5678 in Orange County Court. The function expects case_number, court, details optional. We want both status and trial_date. The function signature says details can be "status" or "trial_date". It doesn't support multiple details at once. So we might need to call twice per case? But maybe we can call with details unspecified to get default 'status'? But we need both status and trial_date. We could call twice per case: once for status, once for trial_date. That would be 4 calls. But maybe the function can return both if details omitted? The description: "Specific details required about the court case. Defaults to 'status'." So if omitted, returns status only. So we need to call twice per case. Let's do that.

We'll call court_info_get_case_status for XY1234, Los Angeles County Court, details="status". Then again for XY1234, Los Angeles County Court, details="trial_date". Then same for GH5678, Orange County Court.
